requirements_summary: Primary workload: embeddings + semantic search for in-app knowledge and support routing
Throughput: backfill ~2M docs over 2 weeks (target ~2k-4k docs/sec during backfill), steady-state embed-ingest ~100-300 reqs/sec
Query SLOs: top-K retrieval latency target <= 50ms for cold queries, P95 <= 120ms during peak
Vector DB: currently using pgvector for metadata queries; evaluating Pinecone and Milvus for scale
Batch jobs: daily incremental job (50k new docs/day), hourly micro-batches for recent updates
Cost sensitivity: mid-market price band; want predictability (reserved/dedicated pricing) for 6-12mo
Model preferences: open to open models (LlamaX, Mistral variants) or Redwood-curated embeddings; accuracy > baseline transformer embeddings
Routing/fallback: prefer hosted for rapid POC, fall back to smaller quantized variant in Dedicated if throughput constrained
Compliance: SOC2 in scope, SSO+SCIM for team provisioning, EU data residency for 10% of customer data
poc_plan: Phase 1 (Hosted API): ingest 200k doc sample, run 3 retrieval configs, measure recall/latency/cost
Phase 2 (Backfill sim): simulate 2M doc backfill via batch upload to evaluate throughput and throttling behavior
Phase 3 (Dedicated sizing): run same workload on Dedicated demo for comparative p99 latency and GPU utilization
Phase 4 (Integration): validate connector to pgvector + small pilot with Pinecone; verify cold-start behavior
Deliverables: perf matrix (latency/cost/throughput), recommended Dedicate sizing, security signoff checklist
